name: disable_all_object_control

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_DisableAllObjectControl does not access or change the Script value stack

notes: ScriptCommand_DisableAllObjectControl selects the active scene-object registry, resolves each registered object ID, and queues operation type 14 for every resolvable object. Type 14 maps to the embedded CONTROL_OFF name; its dispatcher sets the control-disable flag 0x100000000 and clears object-state flag 0x4. The JP corpus contains 118 calls in 112 entries; 76 calls begin an entry, consistent with disabling scene-wide object control at event setup.
